key_insight: ViTeX-Bench introduces a benchmark for evaluating how well models can edit text inside videos while keeping motion, scene structure, and visual realism intact. It highlights that video scene text editing is much harder than image editing because the edit must stay consistent across time.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of a standard evaluation benchmark for high-fidelity video scene text editing. This task requires replacing text on signs, labels, or boards in video without breaking temporal consistency, surrounding content, or camera motion.
method: Defines a benchmark tailored to video scene text editing quality and temporal preservation.
Evaluates edits on both local text replacement fidelity and global video consistency across frames.
Focuses on realistic scene types such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels.
impact: This benchmark gives researchers a common way to measure progress on a difficult video editing task. For practitioners, it helps identify whether a model can produce visually convincing edits that remain stable over time, which is essential for real-world video manipulation.

paper_title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
paper_authors: Xinghao Chen, Xiangbo Gao, Jiongze Yu, Yuheng Wu, Zhengzhong Tu
